PROP-56ad1eb2-inv-029.text: get_blob_parameters sorted schedule must select the highest-epoch entry not exceeding the query epoch.
PROP-56ad1eb2-inv-029.assertion: forall epoch e: get_blob_parameters(e) == entry with max(entry.EPOCH) where entry.EPOCH <= e

locations.note: Selector assumes blob_schedule sorted descending. Uses find_map (no .rev()) — returns first match, i.e. lowest epoch >= query if data is ascending.
Serde path: sorted_list_desc_by_key enforces descending order on YAML deserialization. Named-network constructors bypass this.
Named-network config: blob_schedule defined in ASCENDING order (epoch 274176, then 275712). Bypasses serde sorting — inconsistent with selector's descending assumption.
